lines.text: Here's everything the Cheeko app can do!
lines.show: Here's everything the Cheeko app can do!

lines.text: Four tabs. Home, Device, Analytics and Profile.
lines.show: Four tabs. Home, Device, Analytics and Profile.

lines.text: Home shows your child's day. How long they played, and how many talks, cards and games.
lines.show: Home shows your child's day. How long they played, and how many talks, cards and games.

lines.text: Tap Review to read today's chats. Their questions, and Cheeko's answers, word for word.
lines.show: Tap Review to read today's chats. Their questions, and Cheeko's answers, word for word.

lines.text: Tap a character to see just their chats.
lines.show: Tap a character to see just their chats.

lines.text: Daily Quiz shows how Quizzy's questions went.
lines.show: Daily Quiz shows how Quizzy's questions went.

lines.text: And the streak counts the days in a row they've kept it up.
lines.show: And the streak counts the days in a row they've kept it up.

lines.text: Scroll down for the moment of the day, everything they imagined, and the cards they played.
